Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from this game, and India Women's next game of this Tri-Series is against South Africa Women. That game will be played on Saturday, the 28th of January at the same venue and will begin at 10.30 pm IST (5 pm GMT). You can however join us a lot early for the build-up. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Smriti Mandhana (74* off 51 balls) is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. Mandhana says they did not know what to expect off the wicket in the first game. Adds that they were better prepared for this game and learned quickly how to bat on this wicket. Says that they did not want to go hard from the start and play sensibly. Concludes by saying that she is happy with the partnership between herself and Kaur went really well for them.

The India Women captain, Harmanpreet Kaur says that they didn't want to hurry with the bat and wanted to keep wickets in hand and that worked out well. Adds that they discussed about the batting performance as the pitch here wasn't an easy one and goes on to applaud the way Smriti Mandhana batted and that took the pressure off her as well. Mentions that she wasn't available for the first game but is happy to be able to do well in this game.

Hayley Matthews, the captain of West Indies Women says that she had a conversation with Campbelle in the middle to get going after the halfway mark. Adds that it was important to show some intent. She lauds India Women for their really good innings but is upset about the missed chances. Concludes by saying that it’s a must-win game for them against South Africa Women next time around and they will look to take positives from this game and do well in the next game.
The Presentation ceremony...

Earlier in the game, Harmanpreet Kaur returned to captain India Women and opted to bat first. After a bit of a sluggish start and losing two wickets in 8.2 overs, the skipper along with Smriti Mandhana just overpowered the West Indies Women bowlers. The pair put on an unbeaten stand of 115 runs as Mandhana top-scored with 74 not out. Shanika Bruce and Shamilia Connell were good up front with the ball for West Indies Women but that was it as all the other bowlers were taken to the cleaners. Coming to the chase, the Indian spinners showed their class and picked up early wickets to have the opposition reeling at 39/3 at the halfway mark. Even though the Windies Women were able to up the ante in the next 10 overs, it was the start that killed the game for them.

West Indies Women were under the pump at the halfway mark and the shuffle in the batting order didn't work either. Britney Cooper fell for a duck with Rashada Williams and Shabika Gajnabi following suit. Then came the gritty stand between skipper Hayley Matthews and Shemaine Campbelle worth 71 runs. It was sedate for a while but after the halfway mark, the pair was able to find the fence with regularity. Campbelle fell but Matthews stayed on. Neither batter could surpass the 50-run mark and West Indies Women were completely outplayed in all aspects of the game.

A fairly comfortable win for India Women and they cruise to back-to-back wins in the series and now sit pretty on top of the table. They had a big total on the board and the bowlers were right on the money from the off. Deepti Sharma picked up a couple of early wickets to set the tone and then Rajeshwari Gayakwad made it three soon. After that, the bowlers were able to keep the runs in check but failed to pick up a wicket. The pacers seemed mostly ineffective but spin continued to dominate and apart from Devika Vaidya everyone else was fairly economical. Radha Yadav got herself on the wickets column and India Women picked up an easy win.

Shikha Pandey dishes out a full ball on off, and Afy Fletcher works it through the cover-point region for one as West Indies Women finish on 111 for 4 in their 20 overs falling short by 56 runs in the end. Brilliant win for the India Women as they make it two out of two in the Tri-Series.
A low full toss on off, Afy Fletcher pushes it to Harmanpreet Kaur at mid-off.
Very full and outside off, Afy Fletcher goes for the drive and misses.
Full and on off, Hayley Matthews flays it though the off side to deep extra cover for one.
Full and into the blockhole on the leg pole. Hayley Matthews blocks it out.
Full and on the leg peg, Hayley Matthews whips it to short mid-wicket.
Shikha Pandey (3-0-16-0) to bowl the final over.
Full and on off, Afy Fletcher drills it back to Deepti Sharma who dives to her right and saves the ball.
Low full toss and Afy Fletcher reverse sweeps it to point.

FOUR MORE! Full and on the pads, Afy Fletcher works it through the mid-wicket region as the ball races past the turf for four. Jemimah Rodrigues slides and tries to stop but misses and the ball rolls away into the fence.
Short and outside off Afy Fletcher cuts it to covers.
FOUR!! WHIPPED! Full and on the leg. Afy Fletcher whips it nicely of the middle and it runs away between long on and deep mid-wicket for four.
Slider goes on with the arm, Afy Fletcher looks to flick and misses, takes it on her pad.
Deepti Sharma (3-0-21-2) is back on to finish her spell.

FOUR!! BANG! Full and on the stumps. Hayley Matthews makes room and lofts it over the extra cover region for a boundary. A good way to end the over by Hayley Matthews as West Indies Women goes past 100.
Full and down the leg, Afy Fletcher whips it to deep square leg for one.
Fuller on off, Afy Fletcher pushes it to mid-off.
Afy Fletcher is the new batter in.

OUT! GONE! CAUGHT! Low full toss dipping on the batter, Shemaine Campbelle uses her feet and takes it on the full, swats it to the deep mid-wicket region. Amanjot Kaur at the boundary runs around to her left and takes a terrific catch springing to that side to dismiss Shemaine Campbelle for 47. The partnership is broken and West Indies Women lose their fourth.
Commentary.Howout: c Amanjot Kaur b Radha Yadav

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up on off. Shemaine Campbelle uses her feet and drills it back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, Shemaine Campbelle cuts it to covers.
Radha Yadav (3-0-5-0) is back into the attack.
Short and around off, Shemaine Campbelle goes back and bunts it down to long on for one.
Full and on the stumps, Shemaine Campbelle bunts it to the right of the bowler.
SIX! BANG! Tossed up on the leg peg, Shemaine Campbelle uses her feet and swings hard over the long on region for a maximum. Terrific hit.
Length ball on the stumps, Hayley Matthews works it through covers for one.
Tossed up outside off and turns a tad away, Hayley Matthews gets on one knee to slog it away and misses.
Tossed up on off, Shemaine Campbelle drops it to point for one.
Very full and at the stumps, this is pushed right back past the keeper for a single.
This is pitched up on off stump, Shemaine Campbelle drives it right back at the bowler who makes the stop.
Keeps it full and bowls it on middle and leg, Shemaine Campbelle tucks it straight to mid-wicket.
Full and on leg stump, this is flicked away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR LEG BYES! Wrong line again from Shikha Pandey. This is very full and angling down leg. Hayley Matthews gets a tickle off the pad and the ball runs away into the fine leg fence for a boundary.
A low full toss, swinging into the pads. Hayley Matthews fails to get any bat on it and gets hit on the pads.
Shikha Pandey (2-0-14-0) is back into the attack.
Tossed up outside off, Hayley Matthews drives it through mid off for a run.
Leg bye! Floated up on the pads, Shemaine Campbelle looks to tickle it fine but gets it off the pads toward short fine leg. They get a leg bye.
Nicely bowled! Tossed up around off and turning away, Shemaine Campbelle edges it with soft hands toward backward point.

A huge mix-up but no harm is done. This is full on middle, Shemaine Campbelle flicks it to mid-wicket and looks for the single. Hayley Matthews sends her back and Harmanpreet Kaur fires in a throw toward the keeper. Yastika Bhatia whips off the bails as Campbelle puts in the dive and she just manages to get home.
Shorter and around middle, Shemaine Campbelle pulls it hard but Harmanpreet Kaur at mid-wicket makes a sharp stop.
Slower through the air and bowled shorter outside off, Shemaine Campbelle taps it toward the cover region.
Fuller and around middle, this is pushed down the ground for one.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Floated up on a length and outside off, Shemaine Campbelle drags the slog and flat-bats it toward the mid-wicket fence for a boundary. The 50-run stand is up between these two as well.
FOUR! Thumped! Full and straight, Shemaine Campbelle hammers it right back over the bowler's head and picks up a boundary.
Very full and on leg stump, Hayley Matthews gets an inside edge off the pads toward short fine leg and collects a single. There is an appeal for lbw but it is given as runs.
Flighted delivery full and on leg stump, Shemaine Campbelle comes forward and flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
This is flatter and on middle, Hayley Matthews punches it off the back foot and down to long on for a single.
Deepti Sharma (2-0-9-2) is back into the attack.
A tad shorter on middle, Shemaine Campbelle paddles it 'round the corner for a couple of runs.
Holds it back a touch now and floats it up around off. This one turns away and beats the bat as Shemaine Campbelle looks to sweep.
Bows it quicker and slides it in from outside off, Shemaine Campbelle pushes it out on the offside.
On a length on middle and leg, Hayley Matthews flicks it straight to mid-wicket and scampers through for the single.
Slower and shorter outside off, Hayley Matthews looks to rock back and cut but misses.
This is tossed up on the pads, Shemaine Campbelle tucks it toward deep square leg for one. They look for two but decide against it.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad (2-0-3-1) is back on.
Length again on off, Shemaine Campbelle chops it again through covers for one.
Length around off, Shemaine Campbelle taps it to covers. Looks to a single but is sent back.
Full and outside off, Hayley Matthews drives it to third man region for one.
FOUR!! Length ball on off, Hayley Matthews cuts it through the backward point region for yet another four. Hayley Matthews is putting up a fight.
Length and outside off, Shemaine Campbelle pushes it to covers for one.
Short and outside off, Shemaine Campbelle looks to cut and misses.
Amanjot Kaur (1-0-3-0) is back on.
FOUR! 4th boundary in the over. Full and down the leg, Hayley Matthews sweeps it to the fine leg region for yet another boundary.
FOUR MORE! Short and outside off, Hayley Matthews cuts it nicely and bisects the fielder in the point region for a boundary.
Tossed on off, Hayley Matthews presses forward and defends.
FOUR!! Short and outside off, Hayley Matthews rocks back and cuts it through the backward point region for a boundary.
Leg break around off, Shemaine Campbelle drops it to the off side and takes one.
FOUR!! Full toss on the stumps, Shemaine Campbelle picks up and puts it away to the deep square leg region for a boundary. Freebie to start by Devika Vaidya.

DRINKS! At the halfway mark, West Indies Women are reeling at 39/3 and need a further 129 runs to win off just 60 balls. The top order was undone by some quality spin bowling, especially by Deepti Sharma who picked up a couple of wickets. The India Women bowlers have offered any freebies either and have kept things tight. Hayley Matthews is still out there and will look to make sure that her side bats out the full quota and put up a real fight.
Full on off. Hayley Matthews prods ahead and defends. A dot to end the over. West Indies Women are 39 for 3 at the halfway mark.
Full and on the stumps, Shemaine Campbelle uses her feet and hits it down to long on for a single.
Length ball on the leg peg. Hayley Matthews makes room and slaps it down to long on for one.
A low full toss on the stumps, Shemaine Campbelle hits it down to long on for a single.
Full and on the stumps, Shemaine Campbelle bunts it to the onside.
Full and on the stumps, Shemaine Campbelle advances and gets a thick outside edge to point for none.
Full and on the stumps, Shemaine Campbelle drills it past short mid-wicket down to long on for a single to end the over.
Floated on the stumps, Hayley Matthews drives it nicely past the short mid-wicket towards long on for one.
Tad short on the stumps, Shemaine Campbelle rocks back and pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Length ball on the pads, Hayley Matthews turns it to the onside for one.
Tossed up on the leg peg, Shemaine Campbelle uses her feet and chips it over the bowler down to long on for one.
Tosses it up outside off, Hayley Matthews drives it through covers for one.
Back of a length outside off, Shemaine Campbelle pushes at it and the ball goes past the outside edge. A dot to end the over. A tidy start from Amanjot Kaur.
Length and on the stumps. Shemaine Campbelle plays it back to the bowler.
Length and outside off, Hayley Matthews punches it to deep point for one.
Length ball around off, Shemaine Campbelle prods forward and gets an inside edge as the ball runs down to fine leg for one.
Full and on the stumps, Shemaine Campbelle presses forward and defends.
Back of a length tad outside off, Shemaine Campbelle pokes at it and gets beaten.
Amanjot Kaur starts off with a Length ball going down the leg, but Shemaine Campbelle misses on the flick. WIDE called.
Amanjot Kaur to have a bowl now.
Tossed on the stumps. Shemaine Campbelle uses her feet and bunts it down to long on for one.
Full and Hayley Matthews drills it past the bowler who misfields and allows the batter to take one.
Tossed up on the stumps, Hayley Matthews drives it to covers.
Length around off, Hayley Matthews hangs back and defends.
The skipper, Hayley Matthews walks in with West Indies Women in a spot of bother.

OUT! GONE!! LBW! Quicker arm ball from Rajeshwari Gayakwad. Shabika Gajnabi plays on the back foot and gets wrapped on the pads in front of the stumps. A huge appeal and the umpire gives it out. An easy decision for the umpire as India Women pick their 3rd one. Shabika Gajnabi departs for 3.
Tossed up on off, Shabika Gajnabi dabs it to point.

Stifled appeal for lbw but it is turned down. This is nicely flighted on a length and drifted onto middle and leg. Shemaine Campbelle looks to block but misses and gets hit on the pads. After the Powerplay, West Indies Women are 25/2!
Sliding onto the pads, Shabika Gajnabi works it 'round the corner and they do finally get the single.
This is bowled on middle and leg, nudged away onto the leg side.
A bit of hesitation and they don't take the single. This is full on off, Shabika Gajnabi drives it back to the bowler who gets a hand on it and the ball deflects toward mid on.
This is shorter and around off, it is the arm-ball. Shabika Gajnabi hits it straight to extra cover.
Starts off with a full toss on leg stump, Shabika Gajnabi flicks it straight to mid-wicket.
Radha Yadav comes into the attack.
Floated up around off, Shemaine Campbelle just eases it to cover. Just the single then from that over.
Fuller and on middle, tucked away to short mid-wicket.
Three dots in a row now from Rajeshwari Gayakwad. This is flatter on middle and leg, nudged away behind square on the leg side.
This is bowled at the stumps, Shemaine Campbelle pushes it to the right of the bowler.
Slightly more round-arm this and fuller too, Shemaine Campbelle pushes it out on the off side.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad comes into the attack and starts off with a flatter delivery on off stump. Shabika Gajnabi plays it off the back foot in front of point for a single.
This is flatter and around off, Shemaine Campbelle cuts it late down to third man and they race back for the second. Good running.
Shorter and around off, dabbed down to backward point for one.
Through everything! This is flighted around off stump, this time Deepti Sharma gets it to drift in. The ball grips and turns square, going past the inside edge and just over the stumps as well.
Shabika Gajnabi is the new batter coming in at number 4.

OUT! STUMPED! Sharp work from Yastika Bhatia behind the stumps and Rashada Williams has to walk back as well. Deepti Sharma tosses it up full and outside off and gets a bit of drift away from the right-hander. Rashada Williams looks to loft it over mid off and ends up dragging her back leg out of the crease. Bhatia is quick to whip off the bails and the square-leg umpire raises the finger.
Commentary.Howout: st Yastika Bhatia b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Nicely drifted onto middle, Shemaine Campbelle flicks it off the inner half of the bat behind square leg for one more.
Tossed up very full and outside off, Rashada Williams reaches out and pushes it down to long on for a single.
This is full and well outside the off stump but the ball shapes back in a touch. Shemaine Campbelle leaves it alone but no wide is called.
FOUR! Shemaine Campbelle does take advantage of the free hit. This is banged in short outside off, Campbelle drags the pull and flat-bats it over mid on for a boundary.
NO BALL! A beamer from Shikha Pandey, Rashada Williams reaches out and hits it baseball-style to deep mid-wicket for only a single Free Hit coming up.
Good length around the hips, Rashada Williams looks to tuck but misses and the ball flicks the thigh pads.
Back of a length around off, Rashada Williams mistimes the pull shot to wide mid on.
Beaten! This is the leg cutter from Shikha Pandey, bowled on a good length and in that channel around off. Rashada Williams looks to play at it but the ball zips past the outside edge.
WIDE! On a good length and angling down the leg side. Left alone for a wide.
This is full on middle and leg, clipped away toward mid-wicket.

EDGED AND FOUR! Nagging length and on a tighter line around off stump. Shemaine Campbelle has a dab at it and gets an outside edge to the left of Harmanpreet Kaur at first slip. Kaur can't get down in time and the ball runs away into the third man fence.
Floated up and gets it to drift again, Shemaine Campbelle keeps it out.
Tosses it up now on off stump, Shemaine Campbelle tentatively blocks it out.
Lovely delivery again from Deepti Sharma. This one is drifted onto off stump but swerves away from the right-hander beating the outside edge. Shemaine Campbelle has no idea what happened there.
Nicely flighted on off stump, Shemaine Campbelle pushes it toward mid on.
Shemaine Campbelle is the new batter in at number 3.

OUT! LBW! Deepti Sharma starts from the opposite end and picks up a wicket off the very first ball. Sharma tosses it up full and around off stump. Sharma gets the ball to drift and extracts spin as well. Britney Cooper looks to block it off the front foot but is beaten all ends up and gets a rap on the pads. There is an appeal and the finger is raised. Cooper departs for a golden duck.
Good length around off, Rashada Williams looks to open the face of the bat and run it fine but hits it straight to backward point.
Fuller and swinging it into the pads, Rashada Williams chips it in front of mid-wicket and picks up a couple of runs.
FOUR! A bit of width and Rashada Williams latches onto it. This is on a length and outside off, Williams throws her hands at it and hammers it over covers for a boundary.
Keeps it on a good length and shapes it back in a long way from around middle. Rashada Williams has a swipe across the line but is well beaten and the ball flicks the thigh pad.
On a good length around middle and shaping back in a long way. Rashada Williams gets caught on the crease and misses the ball. The ball hits her high on the pads.
Big swing again! This is a bit fuller and around middle, swinging into the right-hander. Rashada Williams nudges it onto the leg side.
WIDE! Starts with a bit of a loosener does Shikha Pandey. This is on a length on leg stump and swinging down the leg side. West Indies Women are underway with a wide.
